keyLimits.en: 25 monthly credits (1 credit = 1,000 transformations, or 1 GB storage, or 1 GB image bandwidth), 3 users, 1 account.
225 monthly credits, 3 users, 2 accounts; adds S3 bucket backup, auto-tagging search, expedited support, asset access controls.
600 monthly credits, 5 users, 3 accounts; adds custom domain support, HTTPS SSL certificate, and additional authentication options.
Custom pricing; multi-CDN infrastructure, enterprise SLAs, dedicated customer success manager, SSO, compliance reviews.

cautions.en: Video bandwidth consumes credits twice as fast as image bandwidth (1 credit = 1 GB image bandwidth vs. 2 GB video bandwidth), which can matter for video-heavy usage.
A separate Digital Asset Management (DAM) product line exists with its own 30-day free trial (25 GB storage, 3 users) and custom enterprise pricing, distinct from the core media API plans.

capabilities.en: Image and video upload, storage, transformation and optimization via API, widgets and a web console.
Global CDN delivery of media assets with automatic format/quality optimization.
Auto-tagging and AI-assisted asset search on paid plans.
S3 bucket backup and custom domain/SSL support on paid plans.

limitations.en: The free plan caps usage at only 25 monthly credits, which is easily consumed by a video-heavy or high-traffic site.
Advanced authentication and custom domain/SSL support require at least the $249/month Advanced plan.

reason.en: General-purpose cloud storage sometimes used for basic media hosting, though without Cloudinary's transformation/CDN pipeline.
Digital asset management competitor targeting teams that need brand asset libraries rather than a developer-first media API.
General cloud storage alternative for basic file/media hosting needs.
